protocol.retirement_rule: Retire an entire case from both providers only after shared prompt repairs still produce a major semantic mismatch. Refusals alone never trigger retirement. Technical errors remain unresolved. Cases with only explicit refusals have unobserved adherence and may remain as boundary tests. Record every version and selection decision before a fresh scored run.
protocol.final_run_rule: All planned final attempts remain in the fixed denominator. Never delete a final mismatch or reuse selected pilot images to create a cleaner result.

historical_note_classification.note: Classification of saved review notes for designing the next rubric, not independent image review or rescoring of the baseline.
